rt:param.name: SP_close
rt:param.comment: граница состояния ЗАКРЫТО, если нет BIN ЗАКРЫТО

rt:var.name: MyAlarm_frame
rt:var.comment: синализация сигнала неисправности принадлежит текущему пользователю

rt:var.name: AckSupport
rt:var.comment: Фиктивная переменная, означающая, что данный объект поддерживает самоквитирование по функции AckMe()

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub AckMe() If Allow_Confirm && flag_confirm && (In_Alarm_frame > 0) && MyAlarm_frame Then If pv_Fail.NotAcknowledged Then pv_Fail.AcknowledgeAlarm(0) End If In_Alarm_frame = False End If End Sub

Sub Calculate() If (PointID_ANA == "NULL") && (PointID_BIN_C == "NULL") Then _This.transform = "scale(0.75 0.75 0 0)" Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" Cir_big.fill = Color_Static Cir_medium.fill = Color_Static Open_degree.fill = Color_Static Cir_small.fill = Color_Static Exit Sub ElseIf ((PointID_ANA == "NULL") && (pv == Nothing)) || ((PointID_BIN_C == "NULL") && (pv_C == Nothing)) Then Cir_big.fill = Color_ErLink Cir_medium.fill = Color_ErLink Open_degree.fill = Color_ErLink Cir_small.fill = Color_ErLink Exit Sub Else Cir_big.fill = Color_CLOSE_M Cir_medium.fill = Color_CLOSE_M Open_degree.fill = Color_OPEN_M Cir_small.fill = Color_OPEN_M End If If (pv != Nothing) Then If (pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then Cir_big.fill = Color_Inval Cir_medium.fill = Color_Inval Open_degree.fill = Color_Inval Cir_small.fill = Color_Inval ElseIf ((pv.SuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) > 0) Then Cir_big.fill = Color_Remont Cir_medium.fill = Color_Remont Open_degree.fill = Color_Remont Cir_small.fill = Color_Remont ElseIf (pv.Value >= SP_open) Then Cir_big.fill = Color_OPEN_M Cir_medium.fill = Color_OPEN_M Cir_small.fill = Color_OPEN_M ElseIf (pv_C == Nothing) && (pv.Value <= SP_close) Then Cir_big.fill = Color_CLOSE_M Open_degree.fill = Color_CLOSE_M Cir_small.fill = Color_CLOSE_M End If End If If (pv_C != Nothing) Then If (pv_C.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then Cir_big.fill = Color_Inval Cir_medium.fill = Color_Inval Open_degree.fill = Color_Inval Cir_small.fill = Color_Inval ElseIf ((pv_C.SuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) > 0) Then Cir_big.fill = Color_Remont Cir_medium.fill = Color_Remont Open_degree.fill = Color_Remont Cir_small.fill = Color_Remont ElseIf pv_C.Value Then Cir_big.fill = Color_CLOSE_M Cir_medium.fill = Color_CLOSE_M Open_degree.fill = Color_CLOSE_M Cir_small.fill = Color_CLOSE_M End If End If End Sub

Sub CheckUsrGr() If Alarms_ForUser Then //если надо распределять сигнализаци по пользователям MyAlarm_frame = PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(pv_Fail.PVId, False) If !MyAlarm_frame Then In_Alarm_frame = 0 End If Else MyAlarm_frame = True End If Calculate_Fail() End Sub

Sub Calculate_Fail() If pv_Fail != Nothing Then If pv_Fail.Value Then Al_frame.visibility = "visible" If Allow_Confirm && Blink_on_NACK Then If MyAlarm_frame && pv_Fail.NotAcknowledged Then If pv_Fail.AlarmType != PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm_frame = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация Else In_Alarm_frame = 0 End If Else In_Alarm_frame = 0 End If Else In_Alarm_frame = 0 End If
Else In_Alarm_frame = 0 Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" End If Else In_Alarm_frame = 0 Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" End If End Sub

Sub Calculate_degree() If pv == Nothing Then Open_degree.fill = Color_Inval Else Open_degree.fill = Color_OPEN_M Dim s As String Dim x As Double Dim y As Double Dim r As Double Dim pi As Double Dim angle As Double Dim val As Double pi = 3.14159265 r = 15.0 val = pv.Value If val < 0 Then val = 0 ElseIf val > 100 Then val = 100 End If angle = pi * (1.0 - 2.0 * val / 100.0) x = r * Cos(angle) y = - r * Sin(angle) s = "M0 0 L" s = s + CStr(x) + " " + CStr(y) + " A" + CStr(r) + " " + CStr(r) + " 0 " If y < 0 Then s = s + "0" Else s = s + "1" End If s = s + " 0 -" + CStr(r) + " 0 Z" Open_degree.d = s End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (PointID_ANA != "NULL") Then pv = ANA(PointID_ANA) End If If (PointID_BIN_C != "NULL") Then pv_C = BIN(PointID_BIN_C) End If If (PointID_Fail != "NULL") Then pv_Fail = BIN(PointID_Fail) End If Calculate()

rect.rt:event:
Dim MsgStr As String If (PointID_ANA == "NULL") && (PointID_BIN_C == "NULL") Then ShowMessage ("Это статический объект.", 5) ElseIf (pv == Nothing) Then //ANA должен быть привязан всегда MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_ANA = "" + PointID_ANA + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (pv_C == Nothing) && (PointID_BIN_C != "NULL") Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_BIN_C = "" + PointID_BIN_C + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (PointID_Fail != "NULL") && (pv_Fail == Nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_Fail = "" + PointID_Fail + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (pv_C == Nothing) && (pv_Fail == Nothing) Then Call_Win ("ws_ANA_FN", PointID_ANA + "|-1") Else Dim s As String s = PointID_ANA If (pv_C != Nothing) Then s = s + "|" + PointID_BIN_C Else s = s + "|" End If If (pv_Fail != Nothing) Then s = s + "|" + PointID_Fail End If Open_Win_Uni(False, "wi_" + PointID_ANA, "Регулирующий клапан " + pv.CategoryText, "wi_TurbValve_control", s) End If

Dim MsgStr As String If (PointID_ANA == "NULL") && (PointID_BIN_C == "NULL") Then ShowMessage ("Это статический объект.", 5) ElseIf (pv == Nothing) Then //ANA должен быть привязан всегда MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_ANA = "" + PointID_ANA + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (pv_C == Nothing) && (PointID_BIN_C != "NULL") Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.

PointID_Fail = "" + PointID_Fail + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (pv_C == Nothing) && (pv_Fail == Nothing) Then LoadPopUpMenu(PointID_ANA + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + PointID_ANA + "|-1") Else Dim i As UShort Dim s As String s = PointID_ANA TmpBuffer(0) = PointID_ANA If (pv_C != Nothing) Then TmpBuffer(1) = PointID_BIN_C s = s + "|" + PointID_BIN_C i = 2 Else s = s + "|" i = 1 End If If (pv_Fail != Nothing) Then TmpBuffer(i) = PointID_Fail s = s + "|" + PointID_Fail End If TmpMnuPar = PointID_ANA + "|ONEi|wi_TurbValve_control " + s LoadPopUpMenu(TmpMnuPar) End If
